spans.s:
m. (-गः)
1 A mountain.
2 A tree.
E.
न not, गम to go, affix ड, immoveable; or दह to burn, Uṇādi affix ग, ह rejected, and द changed to न.

m. (-गः)
1 A Nāga or demigod so called, having a human face, with the tail of a serpent, and the expanded neck of the Koluber Nāga; the race of these beings is said to have sprung from KADRU, the wife of KAŚYAPA, in order to people Pātāla or the regions below the earth.
2 A serpent in general, or especially the spectacle snake, or cobra capella, (Coluber Naga.)
3 An elephant.
4 A cruel or tyrannical person.
5 A cloud.
6 (In composition,) Pre-eminent.
7 A pin or nail projecting from a wall to hang any thing upon.
8 A small tree, (Mesua ferrea^1.)
9 A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.)
10 A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.)
11 One of the airs of the body, that which is expelled by belching.
12 Betle or

Pān.
13

The name of a country.
n. (-गं)
1

Tin.
2

Lead.
3

One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas; it is one of those termed invariable, and always corresponds to the last half of Amāvāsyā or new moon.
4 The effects of that period on any thing done or happening during it.
E.
नग a mountain, and अण् affix; living or produced in mountainous regions, &c.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Mountain, mountaineer.
m. (-जः)
An elephant.
E.
नग a mountain, and ज born.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced by or of a Nāga, &c.
n. (-जं)
1 Red lead.
2 Tin.
E.
नाग lead, &c. and ज produced.

f. (-णा)
Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum halicacabum.)

f. (-नी)
The goddess DURGĀ.
E.
नग a mountain, and नन्दिनी a daughter, being in one of her characters the daughter of Himāla, the snowy Imaus personified.

m. (-तिः)
Himāla, the personified range of snowy mountains dividing India from Tartary, &c.
E.
नग mountain, and पति lord.

m. (-द् or त्)
1 A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.)
2 An axe, a crow.
2 INDRA.
E.
नग, and भिद् what breaks.

m. (-भिद्)
A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.)
E.
नाग an elephant, and भिद् destroying; the word is sometimes written नागभृत्, from भृत् cherishing.

mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु)
Mountain, mountaineer.
E.
नग, and भू born.

m. (-र्द्धा)
The crest or brow of a mountain.
E.
नग, and मूर्द्धन् forehead.

mf. (-रं-री)
A town, a city.
E.
नग a tree, or according to some, a mountain, रल् affix; having trees or houses like mountains.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Clever, sharp, knowing, (as a buck, a blood, a wag, &c.)
2 Town-born or bred, city, citizen.
3

Nameless.
4

Bad, vile.
n. (-रं)
1 Dry ginger.
2 A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.)
3 A form of writing, the Devanāgarī alphabet.
m. (-रः)
1 A husband's brother.
9 An orange.
2 A lecturer.
4 Denial of knowledge.
5

Fatigue.
6

Desire of final beatitude.
f. (-री)
1 A sort of

Euphorbin.
2

A clever or intriguing woman.
E.
नगर a city, अण् aff.

m. (-तः)
An elephant.
E.
नगर a city, and घात who destroys or subverts.

m. (-नः)
Towns-folk, citizens.
E.
नगर, and जन people.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
City, citizens.
E.
नगर, and स्थ who or what stays.

f. (-णी)
A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.

m. (-कः)
A crow.
E.
नगरी, and वक a crane, the town-crane.

m. (-न्तं)
Suburb, skirts of the town.
E.
नग, and उपान्त vicinity.

f. (-धिः)
The plantain.
E.
नगर a city, and औषधि a medicament.

m. (-नः)
A monkey.
E.
नग a mountain, अट to go, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-पः)
Himāla: see नगपति.
E.
नग a mountain, and अधिप a lord; also नगाधिराज, &c.

m. (-पः)
The great serpent ANANTA.
E.
नाग a serpent, and अधिप a king.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Living in or frequenting mountains.
E.
नग, and आश्रय abode.

n. (-यं)
The elevation of a mountain.
E.
नग, and उच्छ्राय heighth.

m. (-काः)
1 A bird in general.
2 A lion.
3 A fabulous animal: see शरभ.
4 A crow.
E.
नग a tree, a mountain, and ओकस् a house or dwelling.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Naked.
m. (-ग्नः)
1 A naked mendicant.
2 A

Bauddha.
3

A bard.
f. (-ग्ना)
A naked woman.
E.
नज to be ashamed, affix क्त.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Naked.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-जित्)
The name of a king, father of one of KṚṢṆA'S wives.
E.
नग्न Bauddha, and जित् who conquers.

n. (-त्वं)
Nudity, nakedness.
E.
त्व added to नग्न; also with तल्, नग्नता.

mn. (-हूः-हु)
Ferment, a drug used to throw the mixture for spirituous liquor into fermentation.
E.
नग्न naked, and ह्वे to call, affix. क्विप्, what is called for by the barefaced, shameless, &c.

m. (-टः)
A naked man, but especially a kind of religious mendicant, who wanders about without clothes.
2 A

Bauddha.
3

A Jain.
E.
नग्न naked, and अट who goes; also with कन् added नग्राटक.

f. (-का)
1 A girl before menstruation or about ten years old.
2 A naked woman.
E.
नग्न naked, कन् added, and the fem. form: see नग्नक.

n. (-णं)
Stripping, undressing.
E.
नग्न, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Undressed, stripped, naked.
E.
नग्न, and कृत made, च्चि aff.

m. (-रः)
A small tree, commonly Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea).
E.
नाग, and केशर synonyms of the same plant compounded; the word is also written नागकेसर.

n. (-र्भं)
Red lead.
E.
नाग lead, and गर्भ origin.

f. (-ह्वा)
A plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa): see शारिवा.
E.
नाग a snake, and जिह्वा a tongue.

f. (-का)
Red arsenick.
E.
नाग a snake, जिह्वा a tongue, कन् affix of comparison.

m. (-नः)
Tin.
E.
नाग lead, जीवन proceeding.

m. (-न्तः)
1 Elephant's tooth or ivory; also the tooth of the elephant.
2 A shelf, a pin or bracket projecting from a wall, and used to hang things upon.
f. (-न्ती)
1 A sort of sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.)
2 A whore.
E.
नाग an elephant, and दन्त a tooth.

m. (-कः)
A wooden pin or bracket, projecting from a wall, a shelf.
E.
नागदन्त an elephant's tooth, and कन् affix of resemblance.

f. (-का)
A plant, commonly called Rāmadūtī: see विशल्या.
E.
नागदन्ती a plant, and कन् affix of resemblance.

m. (-मः)
A sort of tree, commonly Parusha.
E.
नाग one of the plants so called, दल a leaf, and उपमा resemblance.

m. (-द्रुः)
Euphorbia.
E.
नाग a snake, and द्रु a tree; being used in offerings to the snake goddess MANASĀ.

m. (-हः)
A large pin or bracket, projecting from a wall like a shelf.
E.
नाग an elephant, and निर्य्यूह projection.

m. (-शः)
1 A weapon of VARUṆA, the regent of water.
2 A sort of noose or knot, used in battle to entangle an enemy.
E.
नाग an elephant, and पाश a binding.

m. (-ष्पः)
1 A tree used in dyeing, (Rottleria tinctoria.)
2 Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea.)
3 The Champaka, (Michelia champaca.)
E.
नाग an elephant, and पुष्प flower.

m. (-न्धुः)
The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
E.
नाग an elephant, and बन्धु friendly, liked.

m. (-लः)
A name of BHĪMA.
f. (-ला)
A creeping plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)
E.
नाग an elephant, and बल strong.

m. (-ल्लः)
The elephant of INDRA.
E.
नाग elephant, and मल्ल a boxer.

f. (-ता)
1 A name of MANASĀ, a goddess supposed to preside over snakes.
2 Red arsenick.
E.
नाग a snake, and मातृ a mother.

m. (-रः)
A sort of potherb; also केशराज.
E.
नाग a snake, and मार destroying; considered as an antidote.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A piece of wood erected in a place dug for water.
E.
नाग a snake, and यष्टि a staff; looking like a snake; also नागयष्टिका.

m. (-कः)
1 The orange: see नागरङ्ग.
2 A thief.
3 An artist.
E.
नगर, and वुञ् aff.

m. (-क्तः)
Red lead.
E.
नाग mountain, and रक्त red.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The orange; in India usually applied to the Silhet orange, (Citrus aurantium).
E.
नाग an elephant, रञ्ज to be sick, affix घञ्; on which elephants feed till they become ill; or नाग red lead, and रङ्ग colour, of the colour of red lead.

f. (-स्ता)
A grass, (Cyperus.)

m. (-जः)
ANANTA, the chief of the Nāgas.
E.
नाग, and राज king.

m. (-टः)
A libertine, a debauchee, a rake, a blackguard.
E.
नागरी an intriguing woman, अट to accompany, affix अच्, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
The orange: see नागरङ्ग.

m. (-णुः)
Red lead.
E.
नाग, and रेणु oxid.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
City, citizen.
E.
नगर a town, and ढकञ् aff.

f. (-ता)
The penis.
E.
नाग a snake, and लता a creeper.

m. (-कः)
The Nāga regions below the earth.
E.
नाग a Nāga, and लोक world.

f. (-का)
The betel plant: see the next.

f. (-ल्ली)
The betel plant, (Piper betel.)
E.
नाग the infernal Nāga, and वल्ली a creeper; the creeper of the lower regions; also with कन् added नागवल्लिका.

m. (-कः)
Garuḍa, the bird of VIṢṆ

A peacock.
3 A royal elephant.
4 An elephant driver or keeper.
5 The chief person in a court or assembly.
E.
नाग an elephant, वृ to cherish, &c. affix ठक्.

m. (-टः)
A rake: see नागरीट.

f. (-थी)
The path of Airāvata, the milky way.
E.
नाग the elephant, वीथी a road or path.

n. (-वं)
Minium or red lead.
E.
नाग lead, and सम्भव production.

f. (-न्धा)
The ichneumon plant: see नाकुली.
E.
नाग a snake, and सुगन्ध perfume.

m. (-ख्यः)
A plant: see नागकेसर.
E.
नाग an elephant, and आख्या a name.

n. (-ङ्गं)
Hastināpura.

f. (-ला)
A stick or pole driven into a square piece of earth in the centre of a newly dug pond, a boring rod.
E.
नाग a snake, and अञ्चला end of a garment; it is also written नागाञ्जना f. (-ना); see नागयष्टि.

m. (-कः)
Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
E.
नाग a snake, and अन्तक a destroyer; this and similar compounds are also applied to the Ardea Argala, the peacock, and other birds who are natural enemies of the serpent genus.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Mounted or riding upon an elephant.
E.
नाग, and आरूढ mounted.

m. (-नः)
Garuḍa: see नागान्तक.
E.
नाग a snake, and अशन food.

n. (-ह्वं)
Hastināpura or ancient Delhi.
E.
नाग an elephant, and आह्वा a name.

n. (-दं)
Armour for the front or the belly.

n. (-रं)
A breast-plate, a cuirass.
